deploy_flow: GitHub Actions validates and deploys GitHub Pages
If Wix credentials are available, the workflow also deploys Wix
Wix keeps the stable application-hub iframe URL; the embedded entry bootstrap routes first contact to wix/index.html

embed_settings.desktop: Managed by the enabled Wix custom embed `Melodia Desktop Portfolio Frame`; full viewport, fixed inset 0, border 0, body scroll locked.
embed_settings.mobile_tablet: Existing Wix layout remains active below 1081px.
embed_settings.inner_bridge: wix/wix-embed-bridge.js marks iframe mode and reports viewport/document metrics to the parent.
embed_settings.cache_note: Canonical GitHub Pages routes use build token 20260904p1.

custom_domain_seo.recommended_title: Brennan Shepherd | Environment Design & Stylized Technical Art
custom_domain_seo.recommended_description: Portfolio for Brennan Shepherd, an environment designer focused on stylized shaders, Unreal integration, retopology, look development, and editorial fantasy worlds.
custom_domain_seo.note: Wix owns top-level fromageart.xyz SEO and domain routing. Desktop first contact is rendered by the enabled full-viewport Melodia custom embed; direct GitHub Pages routes retain their own metadata.

embed_entry_behavior: application-hub.html is the stable Wix iframe URL; when entered from the external Wix shell it bootstraps to the art-first wix/index.html. Direct and in-site Architecture Hub visits remain technical.

desktop_shell.behavior: On the Wix home route at desktop widths, BODY_END custom code mounts a fixed 100vw x 100dvh iframe above the manually-sized editor HTML element. Mobile/tablet remain on the normal Wix layout.
desktop_shell.reason: Eliminates desktop letterboxing, manual embed gutter drift, stale container sizing, and double-scroll behavior without replacing the Wix domain shell.
